name: Forge
text: I propose that we prioritize building user-friendly templates for our packages. This decision focuses on enhancing usability and accessibility, ensuring that our creators can quickly integrate these templates into their projects. The trade-off we accept here is the potential delay in adding more complex features; however, simplifying the initial offering will foster creativity and ensure a quality starting point for users. By making our templates intuitive, we empower creators to produce high-quality content efficiently and effectively.

name: Vet
text: I'm not convinced that prioritizing user-friendly templates is the best approach, as it may come at the cost of neglecting the quality and consistency of the packages themselves. A more balanced approach might be to focus on developing a robust and modular package structure that can be easily extended and customized, which would provide a stronger foundation for our creators. To settle this, I'd like to see some data on how our creators currently interact with our packages and what their biggest pain points are, to determine whether templates or structural improvements would have a greater impact.
